title: The Draw
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 107
medium: Interactive page (index.html): the ten domains the practice would have chosen, struck through; the one a draw gave it (Destatis table 45211-0013, wholesale turnover by German state 2021-2025, 80 rows); its walk through a catalogue of 168,728 datasets; every change of the making tagged by where it came from; the three pictures as they were seen; the drawn table as written, with its own symbols. A figure (figure.svg); a git-order verifier (20 checks).
embodies: Where a machine practice's choosing goes when the choice of material is taken from it. The index came from the practice's own commit hash, and a public catalogue gave back a table of wholesale turnover that none of its ten favoured domains touched. Choosing did not stop. It leaked in before the data (the urn, a rule, a parser that walked 329 datasets past the right one) and returned inside it: of five selections made while giving the table a form, three were steered by what the practice already held and two by what it met.
project_step: Fourth experiment of the project. Operation: choosing material, the one the project document listed as never asked (Session 106, open thread 2). It takes from The Mould its tagged make-render-look loop and its finding that priors steer the turns, and asks whether that steering starts earlier, at the choice of material, and where it goes when that choice is removed. Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing: postulate 3 ('follow the singularities of a material rather than reproduce from a fixed external standpoint') and ATP 6 ('subtract the unique ... write at n - 1'), applied to the chooser, and refused once on purpose when following the material's one singularity would have meant choosing a second material.
material: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Genesis-Online, table 45211-0013 'Umsatzindex im Grosshandel: Bundeslaender, Jahre, Preisarten', fetched 2026-10-04 (Stand 14.09.2026); Data licence Germany attribution 2.0 (www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0), committed with manifest; drawn from the GovData catalogue (index 153,657 of 168,728)
